camel_example: aliyun onsmqtt SendMessage --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'post-cn-0pp12gl0000' --MqttTopic TopicA --Payload test
description_en: Sends a single message from an application on a cloud server to ApsaraMQ for MQTT
description_zh: 从服务端应用向云消息队列 MQTT 版发送单条消息
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt send-message --mqtt-topic TopicA --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --payload test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessage

parameters.help_en: The topic to which you want to send a message on the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版的Topic，即消息发送的目标Topic
parameters.name: mqtt_topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can view the instance ID in the Basic Information section on the Instance Details page that corresponds to the instance in the ApsaraMQ for MQTT console (https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台 (https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)实例详情页面的基础信息区域查看
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The message content, which is the payload of the message. We recommend that you encode the content in Base64 to prevent non-printable characters from being transmitted
parameters.help_zh: 消息内容，即消息负载。建议自行做Base64编码，避免传输不可见字符
parameters.name: payload

MsgId.description_en: The unique message ID that is returned by the ApsaraMQ for MQTT broker after the message is sent
MsgId.description_zh: 消息的唯一标识，消息发送成功后服务端会返回消息ID

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID that the system generates for the request. This parameter is a common parameter
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的
